rationale: Both candidates independently catch the same core bug (dp_metadata gating on world_size instead of the MoE mapping, so non-EP DP configs get a spurious collective) and both surface the GT's only substantive concern — that the device_communicator/reduce_scatter assertions only validate the fake's injected attributes rather than the production wrapper. Y goes further with a purely diff-verifiable dead-code catch (the unreachable 'any(count is None)' branch), plus deeper, well-cited investigation into a plausible CFG-parallel hang risk and a link to the red CI gates, giving reviewers concrete, testable next steps. X's findings are valid but shallower and include a weaker, less-grounded nitpick (requirements.txt vllm version pinning) that dilutes precision.
